task_title: [Rin] Premium Perception Recovery｜Media Narrative + Pixel-authoritative Spine + Owner Evidence Integrity

implementation_order.name: Owner evidence integrity first
requirements: Generate owner_html_bundle from the exact final HTML used by the screenshot runner.
Record per-sample final_html_sha256 and per-width screenshot hashes.
Freeze rejected baseline independently; fail if baseline/current HTML provenance collides.
Produce direct 1440/390 no-overlay before/after sheets.

implementation_order.name: Media Narrative Plan layer
requirements: Compile media roles after Family freeze and before rendering.
For every selected scene declare narrative/compositional role, prominence intent, evidence state, crop/layer, copy interaction, transition role, desktop/mobile behavior.
Do not set an arbitrary global image count; derive media breadth/prominence from selected research mechanism and Page Spine.
Fail closed for media-required mechanisms rather than degrade to incidental slots.

implementation_order.name: Page Art Direction Spine v2 as pixel authority
requirements: Spine controls macro silhouette, typography relationship, media rhythm, density/whitespace/contrast arcs, material language, transition grammar, focal scene sequence, CTA cadence and ending.
Remove universal ledger/card/rail treatment as fallback premium skin.
Do not route by identity/category and do not randomize.

implementation_order.name: Perceptual Production Variant implementation
requirements: Upgrade variants from structural renderer identities to perceptual behavior bundles.
Each variant owns composition, type hierarchy, media geometry/layering, space rhythm, material grammar, transition behavior and mobile re-art-direction.
Renderer cannot compress unsupported behavior into a shared generic section.

implementation_order.name: Authored focal scenes
requirements: Compile explicit screenshot-worthy focal moments from the Page Spine.
At least the strongest moments must remain recognizable without copy/metadata explanation.
Do not satisfy this with decorative animation alone.

implementation_order.name: Stage A regenerate + evidence
requirements: Regenerate the same 9 Stage A samples across 9 widths.
Aoi v2 starts with blind 1440/390 single-page and media gates.
Then compare each against latest Shun-rejected baseline before same/cross-family uniqueness.
Only after Aoi v2 PASS route actual HTML to Shun.

do_not: add arbitrary images until count looks larger
change Family because assets are scarce
reuse contaminated before/after owner HTML evidence
definition_of_done: Actual owner-delivery pixels—not metadata—visibly demonstrate the intended benchmark mechanism, meaningful media presence and a clear departure from the rejected visual lineage while preserving truth/rights/family locks.
